summary: Final legal document certifying that building construction strictly matches approved plans and is safe for human habitation.

steps.title: Obtain Architect Completion Certificate
steps.description: Architect and structural engineer sign Form of Completion stating construction follows sanctioned plans.

steps.title: Obtain utility completion memos
steps.description: Procure formal connection memos from sewerage, water supply, and electrical safety wings.

steps.title: Submit OC application online
steps.description: Submit application on municipal building portal attaching all NOCs and photographs of all elevations.

steps.title: Joint engineering inspection
steps.description: Municipal team measures setbacks, room heights, parking area, and fire exits against approved blueprint.

steps.title: Issuance of Occupancy Certificate
steps.description: Municipal Corporation issues Occupancy Certificate enabling permanent utility connections and property sale.
